subject: MAP: capacity & evaluation plan — GPU allocation review for SynthMed
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Ross <tim.ross@synthmed.com>, Alyssa Torres <alyssa.t@synthmed.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-15T09:22:00Z
Subject: MAP: capacity & evaluation plan — GPU allocation review for SynthMed

Hi Tim / Alyssa,

Following our roadmap sync, here's the weekly MAP checkpoint focused on dedicated/private capacity sizing and evaluation timelines. Goal: align on GPU SKU/quantity, regions, and throughput targets so we can finalize the evaluation cluster and start perf runs next week.

Summary proposal (initial):
- GPU SKUs: H100 80GB (primary) or A100 80GB (fallback) — H100 preferred for latency headroom on long contexts.
- Initial capacity: 4 H100s in US-east-1 for evaluation (2 baseline + 2 load), expandable to 8 for the private pilot.
- Secondary region: eu-west-1 (2 H100s) for compliance/regional failover during pilot.
- Throughput targets: interactive inference at ~400 tokens/sec sustained per GPU for typical 1k-token prompts; service-level throughput goal is 1k concurrent reqs at p95 < 250ms for short prompts (we'll tune batching).
- SLOs to test: p50, p95 latencies, and 99th percentile KV-cache cold starts.

Action items (owners):
1) Send final MAP spreadsheet with SKU rows & timelines — owner: monica_patel — due: 2026-03-18.
2) Provision temporary eval pool (4 H100 in us-east-1) — owner: marcus_lin / infra — ETA: 72 hours after sign-off.
3) Security/compliance handoff (SOC2 scoping + traffic isolation) — owner: lauren_bishop — provide checklist by 2026-03-17.
4) Schedule perf run window and test prompt set — owner: Vivek (I'll coordinate) — target week of 2026-03-22.

Attachments: synthmed_map_v2.xlsx (MAP with timelines & proposed SKUs).

Open questions for you:
- Is us-east-1 the preferred primary region for your users?
- Are you comfortable starting with H100s (higher perf) or do you need to justify cost against A100?
- Any additional compliance constraints for eu workloads?

Next step: I'll update the MAP and loop infra once I get your preferred region/sku. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
v: +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: synthmed_map_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.t@synthmed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Ross <tim.ross@synthmed.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: capacity & evaluation plan — GPU allocation review for SynthMed

On 2026-03-15T09:22:00Z Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Following our roadmap sync, here's the weekly MAP checkpoint focused on dedicated/private capacity sizing and evaluation timelines.

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications before we lock SKUs: 
- Primary region: yes, prioritize us-east-1. Most of our dev traffic originates east coast.
- H100s: OK to start H100 for eval, but procurement will need cost delta vs A100 documented for the pilot. Can you include simple delta in the estimate?
- Throughput: 400 tokens/sec per GPU sounds reasonable; can you convert that to expected RPS for our canonical 600-token prompt so we can sync with product?

Also we need a brief security note for our internal GRC folks summarizing data retention and isolation for the private deployment. If lauren can provide that checklist, great.

Tim, do you want us to lock the initial 4-node eval in us-east-1 this week?

—Alyssa
Product Ops — SynthMed

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Ross <tim.ross@synthmed.com>, Alyssa Torres <alyssa.t@synthmed.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: capacity & evaluation plan — GPU allocation review for SynthMed

Vivek / team — picking this up on infra side.

Notes from infra:
- We can have 4 H100s provisioned in us-east-1 within ~48–72 hours after procurement approval. We'll stage with dedicated VPC and private subnet for the testing cluster.
- If cost-sensitivity requires A100s, we can swap with minor perf trade-offs; I'll include a quick perf cost table in the estimate.
- For throughput conversion: 400 tokens/sec for a 600-token average prompt ≈ 0.66 req/sec per GPU sustained (~40 RPS across 4 GPUs assuming even distribution and batching). We'll include both tokens/sec and RPS targets in the MAP.

Attached: redwood_capacity_estimate_v1.pdf — rough cost + perf delta A100 vs H100.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_capacity_estimate_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Tim Ross <tim.ross@synthmed.com>

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-17T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: capacity & evaluation plan — GPU allocation review for SynthMed

Thanks all. Good alignment here.

Decision: lock the initial eval on 4 H100s in us-east-1. We want the pilot to reflect production perf, and procurement will review the cost delta but is OK to proceed for the evaluation window.

Please prioritize:
- ETA for provisioned cluster and access details (credentials + IP allowlist).
- Estimated time to run the canonical test suite (approx how many hours of run to gather p95/p99 stable metrics).

I'll aim to approve the budget for the evaluation by tomorrow EOD. If you can send a short summary for my procurement team that lists SKU counts, region, and projected cost delta, that would speed approvals.

—Tim
CTO — SynthMed Inc.
